def_en: to communicate an idea or feeling
note_ru: Convey the message — донести суть. Про смысл, не про грузы (это транспорт).
example: Words can't convey how grateful I am.
example_ru: Словами не передать, как я благодарен.

examples_extra.en: The photo conveys the mood perfectly.

def_en: to refuse to consider; to remove from a job
note_ru: Dismiss an idea — отмести идею. Dismiss an employee — уволить (формально).
example: He dismissed my concerns with a laugh.
example_ru: Он со смехом отмахнулся от моих опасений.

examples_extra.en: She was dismissed for breaking the rules.

def_en: to see the difference between things
note_ru: Distinguish between A and B. Отличительная черта — distinguishing feature.
example: It's hard to distinguish the twins.

examples_extra.en: Learn to distinguish fact from opinion.

def_en: to remove completely
note_ru: Eliminate errors — устранить ошибки. В спорте — выбыть: eliminated in the semi-final.
example: The new process eliminates paperwork.

examples_extra.en: They were eliminated in the first round.

def_en: to improve the quality of something
note_ru: Формальный improve: enhance the experience. Часто в маркетинге и резюме.
example: Good lighting enhances the photos.

examples_extra.en: The course enhanced my confidence.

def_en: to be more than a limit or expectation
note_ru: Exceed expectations — превзойти ожидания. Exceed the speed limit — превысить скорость.
example: The results exceeded all expectations.

examples_extra.en: Don't exceed the daily dose.

def_en: to become or make bigger
note_ru: Expand the business, expand on an idea — раскрыть мысль подробнее.
example: The café expanded into a chain.

examples_extra.en: Could you expand on that point?
examples_extra.ru: Не могли бы вы раскрыть эту мысль?

def_en: to produce something
note_ru: Generate ideas, generate income, generate electricity — идеи, доход, энергия.
example: The post generated a huge discussion.

examples_extra.en: Tourism generates most of the town's income.
examples_extra.ru: Туризм приносит городу большую часть дохода.

def_en: to put a plan into action
note_ru: План придумывают, а implement — воплощают. Ударение на первый слог.
example: We implemented the new system in March.
example_ru: Мы внедрили новую систему в марте.

examples_extra.en: The changes will be implemented gradually.

def_en: to force something on people
note_ru: Impose a ban / a tax / an opinion. Impose on someone — злоупотреблять чьей-то добротой.
example: The city imposed a parking ban.

examples_extra.en: Don't impose your taste on others.

def_en: to explain the meaning; to translate speech
note_ru: Письменный перевод — translate, устный — interpret. Переводчик-синхронист — interpreter.
example: How do you interpret these results?

examples_extra.en: She interpreted for the delegation.

def_en: to happen; to come to mind
note_ru: Формальный happen. It occurred to me — мне пришло в голову.
example: The error occurs only on Mondays.

examples_extra.en: It never occurred to me to ask.
examples_extra.ru: Мне и в голову не пришло спросить.

def_en: to succeed against a difficulty
note_ru: Overcome fear, overcome obstacles. Формы: overcome - overcame - overcome.
example: She overcame her fear of flying.

examples_extra.en: We overcame every obstacle together.

def_en: to see or understand in a particular way
note_ru: Perceive as: его воспринимают как лидера — perceived as a leader. Восприятие — perception.
example: The change was perceived as a threat.

examples_extra.en: We perceive time differently as we age.
examples_extra.ru: С возрастом мы воспринимаем время иначе.

def_en: to limit something
note_ru: Restrict access — ограничить доступ. Мягче limit, формальнее — restrict.
example: The app restricts screen time.

examples_extra.en: Parking is restricted to residents.

def_en: to try to find or get something
note_ru: Формальный look for: seek advice, seek help. Формы: seek - sought - sought.
example: They're seeking investors for the project.

examples_extra.en: Seek medical advice before the diet.
examples_extra.ru: Перед диетой обратись за советом к врачу.

def_en: to state something exactly
note_ru: Specify the size and colour — укажите размер и цвет. Unless otherwise specified — если не указано иное.
example: Please specify a delivery date.

examples_extra.en: The contract doesn't specify who pays.
examples_extra.ru: В контракте не указано, кто платит.

def_en: to make something start happening
note_ru: Trigger an alarm, trigger a reaction. Существительное — «спусковой крючок» и в прямом, и в переносном.
example: The news triggered a wave of panic.

examples_extra.en: Dust triggers her allergy.

def_en: to strongly advise someone to do something
note_ru: Urge someone to do. Существительное — «позыв»: an urge to laugh.
example: Doctors urge people to get vaccinated.

examples_extra.en: I urge you to read the contract first.

def_en: to check that something is true
note_ru: Verify your email — подтвердить почту. Verify the facts — проверить факты.
example: We couldn't verify his story.
example_ru: Мы не смогли подтвердить его историю.

examples_extra.en: Click the link to verify your account.
examples_extra.ru: Перейдите по ссылке, чтобы подтвердить аккаунт.

def_en: to take money out; to remove or leave
note_ru: Withdraw cash — снять наличные. Withdraw an offer — отозвать предложение.
example: I withdrew two hundred euros.

examples_extra.en: The company withdrew the product.

def_en: to act according to a rule or request
note_ru: Comply with the rules. Комплаенс в компаниях — оттуда же.
example: All ads must comply with the law.

examples_extra.en: He refused to comply with the order.

def_en: to give time or effort to something
note_ru: Devote time to — с to и герундием: devoted her life to teaching.
example: He devotes his weekends to the garden.

examples_extra.en: She devoted herself to the cause.

def_en: to appear or become known
note_ru: New details emerged — всплыли новые детали. Emerging markets — развивающиеся рынки.
example: New evidence emerged last week.
example_ru: На прошлой неделе всплыли новые доказательства.

examples_extra.en: She emerged as the team's leader.

def_en: to make people obey a rule
note_ru: Законы пишут — и enforce: заставляют работать. Law enforcement — правоохранительные органы.
example: The speed limit is rarely enforced here.
example_ru: За соблюдением лимита скорости здесь почти не следят.

examples_extra.en: It's hard to enforce this ban.

def_en: to get something useful or more of something
note_ru: Gain experience, gain weight, gain confidence. Приобретения любого рода.
example: She gained a lot of experience abroad.
example_ru: За границей она приобрела большой опыт.

examples_extra.en: The idea is gaining support.

def_en: to officially give what is asked for
note_ru: Grant a visa, grant permission. Грант на исследование — оттуда же.
example: They granted him a visa.

examples_extra.en: Her request was granted at once.

def_en: to recognise what or who something is
note_ru: Identify the problem — определить проблему. Identify with — отождествлять себя с.
example: We identified three key risks.

examples_extra.en: Can you identify the smell?

def_en: to start something big or new
note_ru: Launch a product, launch a rocket. Запуск — тоже launch: the launch went well.
example: They launched the app in April.

examples_extra.en: The campaign launches next week.

def_en: to not give enough care or attention
note_ru: Neglect your health — запустить здоровье. A neglected garden — заброшенный сад.
example: Don't neglect your sleep during exams.
example_ru: Не пренебрегай сном во время экзаменов.

examples_extra.en: The building has been neglected for years.

def_en: to say you disagree
note_ru: Ударение решает: обJECT — возражать, ОБject — предмет. Object to smoking — возражать против.
example: Nobody objected to the plan.

examples_extra.en: I object to being called lazy.
examples_extra.ru: Я возражаю против того, чтобы меня называли ленивым.

def_en: to say what will happen in the future
note_ru: Predict the result. Прогноз — prediction, предсказуемый — predictable.
example: Nobody predicted this outcome.

examples_extra.en: It's hard to predict the market.

def_en: to cause someone to do something
note_ru: The letter prompted him to call — письмо побудило его позвонить. Prompt как прилагательное — быстрый: a prompt reply.
example: The crisis prompted new rules.

examples_extra.en: Thanks for your prompt reply.

def_en: to remember; to call a product back
note_ru: I don't recall saying that — не припоминаю такого. Отзыв машин с рынка — recall.
example: I don't recall meeting him.

examples_extra.en: The company recalled thousands of cars.

def_en: to look or be like someone or something
note_ru: Без предлога: she resembles her mother, не «resembles on». Только сходство, не сравнение.
example: The building resembles a ship.

examples_extra.en: He closely resembles his brother.

def_en: to experience something difficult or a process
note_ru: Undergo surgery — перенести операцию, undergo changes — претерпеть изменения.
example: The site is undergoing maintenance.

examples_extra.en: He underwent knee surgery.
